clock: An original Fed release declares 09:15 America/New_York. Use the following actual Qlib trading session 09:31 as conservative availability; attach only to a Stage1 signal date at that session close or later. Never use a report on its release date or backfill an observation month to its calendar month.
source_state_policy: Carry the last exact published same-vintage MoM value until a later release becomes available; retain source release date, observation month, base year and age days. Missing 2025-10 latest-month event is not fabricated; the previous release remains last-known until the 2025-12-23 seven-month publication. Report all ages and gaps without selecting an age cutoff from market outcomes.
native_evidence: One D.calendar call over 2010-09 through 2026-10 and exact Stage1 train/held slices
DataHandlerLP.from_df and DatasetH.prepare on all mapped feature rows; compare exact sorted MultiIndex and numerical values
Recorder stores full mapped panel, source event clocks and original source hash; small card reports coverage/age/base transitions only
limitations: Original release archive date and declared clock do not prove historical first receipt on an individual Stage1 host
Index base years 2007/2012/2017 are kept distinct; only within-vintage dimensionless changes are mapped
Source alignment does not prove prediction or economic alpha; a separate matched information screen is required before any Stage1 account
